DitherLightRays.rays: How many rays and how fast they flicker, 0 to 100.
DitherLightRays.reach: How far the rays reach down the box, 0 to 100.
DitherLightRays.position: Where the light sits across the top, 0 (left) to 100 (right).
DitherLightRays.speed: How fast the rays move, 0 to 100.
DitherLightRays.color: The rays, or the first beam.
DitherLightRays.color2: The second beam. A one-colour preset uses color for both.
DitherLightRays.mode: single gives both beams color, multi gives the second color2, random picks a hue when the component appears.
